Five of the six data-raw checkers carry a --self-test that plants mutations and requires each to red: check-checkpoint-sites.R, check-mpl-doc-claims.py, check-oracle-registry.py, check-record-claims.py and check-reference-observations.py, each printing one PASS line per planted mutation. check-abort-remedy-verdicts.R does not: it parses no arguments, so it accepts --self-test and exits 0 having planted nothing, and what it emits is a verdict ledger over committed sweep results rather than a check with a pass/fail a mutation could red.
